body_markdown:
Just in time for Googlebook to hit stores, Logitech announces compatibility of several of its most iconic products with this new category of premium laptops that are the perfect companion for Android phone users.


Logitech and Googlebook have collaborated to deliver Intelligence-driven Productivity, a shared vision bridging Logitech hardware precision with Gemini, designed to unlock natural motion on Google’s new operating system, Googlebook OS. Logitech’s mice and keyboards adapt instantly to individual work styles


and are made to move wherever you take your Googlebook


.


Thanks to Logi Options+ app for Googlebook, users can streamline their Gemini workflow to maximize productivity:


- **Intelligence in your flow:** Map physical buttons on Logitech mice and keyboards to trigger tools like Magic Pointer, Circle to Search and Gemini Dictation/Text.


- **Magic Pointer:** The cursor just got its first glow up in years. Now you can do more than just point and click. Wiggle your cursor (or customize it to a button/key in the Logi Options+ app) to activate Gemini and turn two images into a poster, or see a date and instantly add it to your calendar.


- **Focused productivity:** Customizable buttons on the Logitech mice and keyboards help focused work and increase productivity.


> “Teaming up with Logitech for the launch of Googlebook ensures users get a top workspace experience right out of the box,” says John Solomon, Laptops, Tablets & Android Enterprise, Google. “By bringing physical control to features like Gemini through Logi Options+, Logitech gives people a fast, intuitive way to interact with our new operating system.”


### **A Complete Ecosystem**


Whether navigating spreadsheets with Horizontal Scroll or switching control between Googlebook, mobile devices and tablet with Logitech Easy-Switch, these tools keep workspaces efficient. At launch MX Master 4, MX Anywhere 3S, MX Keys S, MX Keys Mini, Mobi Fold and Keys-to-Go 2 are compatible with Googlebook.


> “Our close collaboration with Google allowed us to be ready on day one, connecting our tools directly to Gemini so helpful intelligence features feel natural to use,” says Delphine Donné, VP & General Manager, Personal Work Solutions at Logitech. “Whether navigating multiple tasks and tabs or pulling up Gemini with a single button, our tools help people work faster and stay focused on what matters.”


Logitech products recommended for Googlebook are available now at


[Logitech.com](http://logitech.com/) and retailers where Googlebook is sold in North America, United Kingdom, Germany, France, Australia and New Zealand.
